advice.zh: 先减少引发疼痛的动作，短时间冷敷，之后按舒适程度热敷和轻柔活动。若无法承重、明显肿胀或数天不缓解，请就医。
advice.en: Reduce the triggering activity. Try a short cold pack, then gentle movement or warmth if comfortable. Seek care for inability to bear weight, marked swelling, or symptoms that persist.

advice.zh: 避免长时间压迫患处，记录麻木范围和变化。若出现肢体无力、说话含糊、面部歪斜或大小便异常，立即急诊。
advice.en: Avoid prolonged pressure and note how numbness changes. Get urgent help for weakness, slurred speech, facial droop, or loss of bladder/bowel control.

advice.zh: 保持清洁干燥，避免抓挠和新用的护肤品。红肿快速扩散、伴发热或流脓时尽快就医。
advice.en: Keep the area clean and dry; avoid scratching and new products. Seek care promptly if redness spreads quickly, fever or pus appears.

structures: 骨骼 + 肌肉 / Bone + muscle

advice.zh: 减少负重，短时间冷敷并观察活动范围。关节明显变形、无法活动或伴高热请尽快就医。
advice.en: Reduce load and use a short cold pack while watching range of motion. Seek prompt care for deformity, inability to move, or high fever.

name.zh: 瘙痒或皮肤表现（参考模式）

advice.zh: 避免抓挠和近期新用的产品，温和清洁并保持干燥。若迅速扩散、明显疼痛、流脓或伴发热，请尽快就医。
advice.en: Avoid scratching and recently introduced products; cleanse gently and keep the area dry. Seek prompt care if it spreads quickly, becomes very painful, drains pus, or comes with fever.

name.zh: 轻微碰撞或淤青（参考模式）

structures: 皮肤 + 软组织 / Skin + soft tissue

advice.zh: 先停止会加重不适的活动，短时间冷敷并抬高患处（如舒适）。疼痛加重、肿胀明显、无法活动或没有明确碰撞原因时请就医。
advice.en: Stop activities that worsen symptoms; try a short cold pack and elevate the area if comfortable. Seek care for worsening pain, marked swelling, inability to move, or a bruise without a clear bump.

name.zh: 肌肉抽筋样表现（参考模式）

advice.zh: 先停下活动，按舒适程度轻柔拉伸和放松，日常补充水分。若反复发生、持续不松或伴明显无力，请就医评估。
advice.en: Pause the activity and gently stretch or relax the area as comfortable; keep up ordinary hydration. Seek evaluation if cramps recur, do not release, or come with marked weakness.

name.zh: 关节肿胀样表现（参考模式）

structures: 关节 + 周围组织 / Joint + surrounding tissue

advice.zh: 减少负重和重复动作，短时间冷敷并观察活动范围。突然严重肿胀、变形、无法承重或伴高热时请尽快就医。
advice.en: Reduce load and repetitive motion; use a short cold pack and watch range of motion. Seek prompt care for sudden severe swelling, deformity, inability to bear weight, or high fever.

name.zh: 麻刺或电击样感觉（参考模式）

advice.zh: 避免长时间压迫患处，记录感觉范围和变化。若突然出现无力、说话含糊、面部歪斜或步行困难，立即急诊。
advice.en: Avoid prolonged pressure and note the area and changes. Get urgent help for sudden weakness, slurred speech, facial droop, or trouble walking.

name.zh: 头部压迫或紧箍样感觉（参考模式）

structures: 头部软组织 + 神经 / Head soft tissue + nerves

advice.zh: 在安静、光线较低的地方休息，补充日常水分并记录诱因。若突然达到最严重、伴发热颈硬、意识改变、无力或视力异常，请立即急诊。
advice.en: Rest in a quiet, dim place, keep up ordinary hydration, and note possible triggers. Seek emergency care for sudden worst-ever pain, fever with neck stiffness, confusion, weakness, or vision changes.

name.zh: 可见皮肤变化（参考模式）

advice.zh: 拍照记录变化，避免抓挠和刺激物，温和清洁。若出现快速扩散、大片起泡、开放伤口或伴发热，请尽快就医。
advice.en: Photograph changes over time, avoid scratching and irritants, and cleanse gently. Seek prompt care for rapid spread, extensive blistering, open wounds, or fever.

conditions.summary: 自发性牙痛或冷热刺激后持续疼痛，可能提示牙髓受累，需要牙科检查确认。
conditions.summaryEn: Spontaneous tooth pain or lingering hot/cold sensitivity can involve the pulp and needs a dental exam.

advice.zh: 先避开冷热甜刺激，保持清洁并预约牙科检查；不要把阿司匹林直接放在牙龈上。
advice.en: Avoid hot, cold and sweet triggers, keep the area clean, and arrange a dental exam; do not place aspirin directly on the gum.

redFlags.zh: 面部或颈部肿胀、发热、吞咽或呼吸困难时立即急诊。
redFlags.en: Go to urgent care now for facial or neck swelling, fever, or difficulty swallowing or breathing.

conditions.summary: 鼻塞、面部压迫感或分泌物改变可见于鼻炎或鼻窦炎，症状本身不能确定病因。
conditions.summaryEn: Congestion, facial pressure or changed discharge can occur with rhinitis or sinusitis; symptoms alone do not confirm the cause.

advice.zh: 补充水分，避免烟雾等刺激，按说明使用盐水清洁；症状持续或反复请咨询医生。
advice.en: Hydrate, avoid smoke and other irritants, and use saline rinses as directed; ask a clinician if symptoms persist or recur.

redFlags.zh: 眼周肿胀或视力改变、剧烈头痛、颈项僵硬或高热时尽快就医。
redFlags.en: Seek prompt care for swelling around the eye, vision changes, severe headache, stiff neck or high fever.

name.zh: 鼻部外伤或鼻出血（可能）

conditions.summary: 碰撞后疼痛、肿胀或鼻出血需要结合受伤经过和外观评估。
conditions.summaryEn: Pain, swelling or bleeding after impact should be assessed with the injury history and appearance.

advice.zh: 坐直并身体前倾，捏住鼻翼软部持续十分钟；不要仰头或把纸巾塞深。
advice.en: Sit upright and lean forward while pinching the soft part of the nose for ten minutes; do not tilt the head back or pack tissue deeply.

redFlags.zh: 出血持续超过二十分钟、鼻形明显改变、头部受伤后嗜睡或清液流出时立即就医。
redFlags.en: Seek urgent care if bleeding lasts over twenty minutes, the nose is visibly deformed, or head injury causes drowsiness or clear fluid drainage.
